# Step - unfold

`unfold` · category: [Lists and ordering](../../traversal/step_reference.md#lists-and-ordering)

Splits a list (or map, into entries) into its elements, one traverser each.

## Forms

```text
unfold()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject([1, 2, 3]).unfold().sum().next()   // 6
```
